name: List auf Sylt (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided green over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of List auf Sylt (a whale on white above a compass on green).
history: Municipal flag of List auf Sylt; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: List auf Sylt arms — whale and compass
